prompt: A basketball player makes $80$ percent of her free throws, and each shot is independent of the others. She shoots two free throws. What is the probability she makes BOTH?
hint: Independent events: the probability of both is the product of the probabilities.

hints.text: Independent events: the probability of both is the product of the probabilities.

explanation: Because the shots are independent, $P(A \cap B) = P(A) \cdot P(B)$.
There is a $64$ percent chance she makes both.

alternativeExplanations.title: Out of 100 trips to the line
steps: In about 80 of 100 trips she makes the first shot.
Of those 80 trips, she makes the second in about 80 percent, which is 64 trips.
